claims.statement: REDUCE days mark deterioration in ALL cycle types (dd depth increases, efficiency_signed_3 falls, turnover load falls vs the R0-5..R0-1 baseline); the MAGNITUDE strongly stratifies the outcome: NO_RECOVERY/FAILED_EXIT deteriorate several times more than RECOVERED_ADD
claims.evidence: det dd: RECOVERED +0.0059/+0.0068 (val/conf) vs NO_RECOVERY +0.0333/+0.0238, FAILED_EXIT +0.0372 (conf only); det cum: RECOVERED ~+0.002 vs NO_RECOVERY -0.0314/-0.0165, FAILED_EXIT -0.0352; all Holm-significant within their families

claims.statement: ADD does NOT mark state repair: at A0 (median 2 days after R0) drawdown is DEEPER, price is LOWER (cum/dist_ref20 below R0), efficiency lower — the re-entry is a low-price buyback, not a confirmation of recovered indicators
claims.evidence: rep levels (RECOVERED_ADD): dd +0.0151/+0.0183 deeper; cum_ret -0.0148/-0.0181 lower; dist_ref20 -0.0151/-0.0191 lower; efficiency -0.0039/-0.0043 lower; turnover -0.0653/-0.0494 lower (only this dimension cools); all CI exclude zero
claims.note: this REJECTS the pre-registered 'deterioration->repair->re-add' reading of Q2 and replaces it with 'deterioration->further-drop->buy-back-lower'
